entries.o: <fe><02><0a><35><31><34><62><5f><30><30><30><39><00>We're not going to get\nthrough without a fight.
<fe><02><0a><35><31><34><62><5f><30><30><32><35><00>Sounds good to me.\nWhat about you guys?
We can use this to climb\ndown the well.
<fe><02><0a><35><32><32><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>I never expected a place\nlike this inside a well...
<fe><02><0a><35><32><32><62><5f><30><30><31><31><00>But it looks like we're\nstuck down here.
<fe><02><0a><35><32><32><62><5f><30><30><33><32><00>I never expected a place\nlike this inside a well...
<fe><02><0a><35><32><32><62><5f><30><30><33><37><00>I never expected a place\nlike this inside a well...
<fe><02><0a><35><32><32><62><5f><30><30><34><34><00>I hadn't noticed that\nwhen it was light...
<fe><02><0a><35><32><34><62><5f><30><30><33><38><00>(So why don't you just\nthrow the chest again?)
<fe><02><0a><35><32><34><62><5f><30><30><34><37><00>(The switch isn't the chest<fc><4a>\nit's on the wall...)
<fe><02><0a><35><33><32><63><5f><30><30><30><33><00>Perhaps this is another\ntrap to confuse us.
<fe><02><0a><35><33><32><63><5f><30><30><33><36><00>How could a cute girl\nlike me be a demon...?
<fe><02><0a><35><33><32><63><5f><30><30><33><39><00>Hmhm... If you're not an ally,\nthen we won't hold back!
<fe><02><0a><35><33><32><63><5f><30><30><34><30><00>That's my line! Don't give\nmy friends the wrong idea.
<fe><02><0a><35><34><32><61><5f><30><30><30><34><00>There's something at\nthe bottom of the lake.
<fe><02><0a><35><34><32><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>Whatever it is, now\nwe can walk through.
<fe><02><0a><35><34><32><62><5f><30><30><31><39><00>I don't think we can\nwade through that.
<fe><02><0a><35><34><32><62><5f><30><30><33><37><00>Thanks to Ein, we know\nwe can't cross on foot.
<fe><02><0a><35><34><33><62><5f><30><30><30><33><00>Can you see that dark\nshadow in the water?
<fe><02><0a><35><34><33><62><5f><30><30><32><33><00>(Even for a random hidden\nstairway, this is odd.)
<fe><02><0a><35><34><33><62><5f><30><30><33><37><00>Yeah, let's push the boulder\nback where it belongs.
<fe><02><0a><35><34><33><62><5f><30><30><34><38><00>The evil emanations\nhave subsided...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><35><34><33><62><5f><30><30><34><39><00>The path to darkness\nhas been sealed off.
<fe><02><0a><35><34><33><63><5f><30><30><30><33><00>It's a different color\nthan the last one.
<fe><02><0a><35><34><34><63><5f><30><30><30><38><00>You'd need thief skills\nto crack that thing...
<fe><02><0a><35><34><34><63><5f><30><30><31><32><00>Maybe I can try it\nwith the Thief Manual?
<fe><02><09><65><34><34><5f><30><30><31><36><00>(Well, Cierra seems she'd be\nscary when angry, too<a2><44>)

<fe><02><0a><35><35><32><62><5f><30><30><30><34><00>It's a switch-controlled\nseal, so...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><35><35><32><62><5f><30><30><30><35><00>if we find the switches,\nthat should do the trick.
<fe><02><0a><35><35><32><62><5f><30><30><30><39><00>(There's three of them,\nin case you didn't know...)
<fe><02><0a><35><35><32><62><5f><30><30><31><32><00>There used to be three.\nOne has disappeared.
<fe><02><0a><35><35><32><62><5f><30><30><31><33><00>They must be related\nto the stake somehow.
<fe><02><0a><35><35><32><62><5f><30><30><31><34><00>I'm sure that's the key\nto opening the seal.
<fe><02><0a><35><35><32><62><5f><30><30><31><35><00>Why don't we check out\nthe other stakes then?
<fe><02><0e><35><35><34><61><5f><30><30><33><5f><30><30><30><34><00>When a certain person reads\nthe spell, it will activate.
<fe><02><0a><34><38><32><62><5f><30><30><31><34><00>We have no choice\nbut to defeat them.
<fe><02><0e><35><35><33><62><5f><36><30><33><5f><30><30><33><33><00>You should tell me about\nthem one of these days.
<fe><02><0a><35><36><32><62><5f><30><30><31><39><00>How strange... Leaving\na book as a memorial?
<fe><02><0a><35><36><32><62><5f><30><30><32><31><00>I don't think it's something\nto be happy about.
<fe><02><0a><35><36><32><62><5f><30><30><32><32><00>It's best to give a person\nwhat they enjoy...
<fe><02><0a><35><36><32><63><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Sorry, Fia... I should have\nlistened to you.
<fe><02><0a><35><36><33><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>It's easy to walk when\nthere's no grass.
<fe><02><0e><35><35><33><62><5f><36><30><33><5f><30><30><33><33><00>You should tell me about\nthem one of these days
<fe><02><0e><35><35><34><61><5f><30><30><33><5f><30><30><30><34><00>When the right person reads\na spell, it will activate.
<fe><02><0a><34><38><32><62><5f><30><30><31><34><00>We have no choice but\nto defeat them
<fe><02><0a><35><37><34><61><5f><30><30><30><31><00>If we use the power of\nthe ankhs...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><35><37><34><61><5f><30><30><30><32><00>We should be able to\ncontrol the water here, too.
<fe><02><0a><35><38><31><62><5f><30><30><30><34><00>Talk about it later!\nLet's get outta here!
<fe><02><0a><35><38><32><62><5f><30><30><30><39><00>We have to defeat them\nbefore we can move on.
<fe><02><0a><35><38><32><62><5f><30><30><31><37><00>Step back, I'm gonna\nwail on this thing!

<fe><02><0a><35><38><32><62><5f><30><30><32><30><00>That will only release\nmore spores into the air,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><35><38><32><62><5f><30><30><32><31><00>making it even more\ndifficult to breathe.
<fe><02><0a><35><38><32><62><5f><30><30><33><36><00>The spores are poisoning\nthe air.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><35><38><32><62><5f><30><30><33><37><00>Cutting them down will\nonly release more!

<fe><02><0a><35><38><32><62><5f><30><30><34><39><00>(We could probably take\nit if we had some way)<fe><00><fe><02><0a><35><38><32><62><5f><30><30><35><30><00>(to protect the Venoma\nfrom outside air.)
<fe><02><0a><35><38><33><62><5f><30><30><31><34><00>We just need to get\nthrough here fast.
<fe><02><0a><35><38><33><62><5f><30><30><32><32><00>I assume thieves never\nmade it this far...
<fe><02><0a><35><38><34><62><5f><30><30><31><36><00>Thanks, everyone. I couldn't\nhave done this alone.
<fe><02><0a><35><39><31><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>The air's too thin here...\n...It's hard to breathe.
<fe><02><0a><35><39><31><62><5f><30><30><30><33><00>How can we be under\nthe lake? It's so dry.
<fe><02><0a><35><39><32><62><5f><30><30><30><39><00>Defeating them is the\nonly way to advance.
<fe><02><0a><35><39><32><62><5f><30><30><33><38><00>If we hadn't stopped\nCierra, you'd be toast.
